strings.name: Svetlana Alexievich
strings.summary: Born in present-day Ukraine, Alexievich grew up in Belarus and studied journalism. Writing in Russian, she selects and arranges interviews into polyphonic documentary literature on women in World War II, the Afghan war, Chernobyl and post-Soviet life. The Unwomanly Face of War and Secondhand Time place emotional experience within larger historical narratives. She won the 2015 Nobel Prize, criticized political repression in Belarus and left in 2020, later living in Berlin.
